messages:
ada: quick flag 0: galen-6b qint8 bringup shows ~4.8% F1 drop on the longform summarization promptset (longsum_v1) vs float. errors look like truncated entity mentions and hallucinated dates. canary run eval/1750012000. float=0.760, qint8=0.712 :thinking:
hugo: ouch. are these long-context examples (>1024)?
ada: most failures are 2048+ tokens, but there are some 512-length examples failing too. pattern looks like kv-cache precision noise in later layers.
jyoti: tokenizer drift check first. did we swap merges or apply fallback vocab for qkernel?
kai: no tokenizer changes in this build. kernel changes were quant packing and int8 matmul tiled kernel. latency down ~18% on canary.
jyoti: OK. can we get the failing example ids and a sampled set for labeling?
ada: grabbing low-confidence bucket now: s3://redwood-evals/ingest/longsum_lowconf/ run a quick dedupe with simhash + ngram overlap

Command I ran:
```
python tools/fingerprint_simhash.py --input s3://redwood-evals/ingest/longsum_lowconf/*.jsonl --out s3://redwood-evals/curation/longsum_qdrop_pool/ --sim-thresh 0.88
```

ada: after dedupe we should target 2.5k gold items prioritized by: 1) longctx (>1500 tokens) 2) entity-heavy 3) low-confidence diff (float vs qint8 disagree)
hugo: label capacity: we have 1.5k humans this sprint unless we deprioritize another queue. we can supplement with rapid-review contractors for the rest.
label-bot: new queue opened: labelflow://queues/longsum-golden-2026-03. items: 2500. tags: longctx, entity-heavy, synth-flag. ETA human-only 72h.
jyoti: for synth fill consider paraphrase-aug + controlled-mask-infill to preserve entities. but mark synth items and keep them to <=20% of gold. small snippet:
```
python tools/synth_mask_infill.py --seed-bank s3://redwood-evals/seed/entity-rich/ --count 500 --out s3://redwood-evals/curation/synth_longsum/
```
kai: I'll run a token-alignment diff to rule out tokenization mismatches:
```
python scripts/token_align_report.py --models galen-6b-float,galen-6b-qint8 --samples 1200 --out /tmp/galen_tokdiff.json\```
hugo: once goldset is ready run compare with stratified buckets (longctx vs mid vs short) and produce per-bucket diffs. example compare command:
```
python evals/compare.py --baseline float --candidate qint8 --gold s3://redwood-evals/curation/longsum_gold_v3/ --stratify buckets.json --out /tmp/longsum_qdrop_diff.json
```
ada: decision rules proposal: - if F1 gap > 3% on longctx bucket -> rollback qkernel and bisect. - if overall gap < 3% but longctx gap > 3% -> enable per-layer higher-precision cache for last 4 layers and re-run. - if entity-preservation metric drops but fluency unaffected -> try mixed-precision KV for entity-attention heads.
jyoti: tagging: please flag examples with {ambig,deid,synth,entity-missed} so evals can filter. also keep a small golden holdout (300 examples) that is human-reviewed twice for stability monitoring.
label-bot: holdout created: s3://redwood-evals/curation/longsum_holdout_doublecheck_v1/ (300 items).
eval-bot: canary eval started by kai at 1750012000 0: https://evals.redwood.internal/runs/1750012000 (artifacts staging). :eyes:
kai: reserving dedicated canary infra tonight, will run full seq-len sweep (512/1024/2048) and post logs.
hugo: after we have labeled gold, also run extractive-span-match metric (entity-preservation) and hallucination-rate (NER-based) before deciding.
ada: agreed. @kai please upload failing example dump and we'll triage labeling priority. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
eval-bot: canary finished at 1750013620 0: artifacts and raw diffs uploaded to s3://redwood-eval-artifacts/1750013620/"
